translation: ⟨Sé⟩ exaltado ⟨sobre⟩ los cielos, Elohim; ⟨el⟩ kavod de ti ⟨sobre⟩ toda ⟨la⟩ tierra.

tokens.notes: Qal imperative 2ms: 'be exalted!' — a command or declaration directed toward Elohim.
Dual form 'shamayim' — always singular in meaning ('heavens, sky').
Plural form used for the God of Israel; retains morphological plural (no aplanar).
Singular collective noun meaning 'all, the whole' (includes implied article).
Heh article + 'erets' — 'the earth/land'. Article explicit in English.
